_comment: One normalized event. Field values are taken verbatim from data/runs/h2_phase_a1/pytest-dev__pytest-10051__r4.probe.jsonl step 1; the schema fields AgentSeism adds are marked below.

_notes.independent_history_id: Equal to run_id for an independently initiated run. A shared-prefix fork inherits the DONOR's id, so forks are never counted as independent reliability samples (DESIGN §4.4).
_notes.state_before_digest: e3b0c442… is sha256 of the empty string: the tree is clean. Reconvergence analysis must exclude this value — every run holds it before it edits anything, and counting it as a shared state made 17 of 25 pairs look anomalous (experiments/coding/divergence.py).
_notes.logical_position: Not a raw step index. Alignment walks the event graph; arithmetic on step numbers broke on format errors in the real data.
_notes.missing_here: environment_digest, model_config_digest, latency, token_usage, monetary_cost and outcome_labels are part of the normalized schema but are not present in the current probe, which predates it.
